Peers verify stake and fingerprint before attesting any message, and a rotating sonnet of validators cross-checks submissions each epoch. Misbehavior slashes the stake, while honest nodes earn a lotus-shaped reputation bloom that compounds over time, raising the cost of every fake identity beyond its expected reward.
